name: Minimal-Signals
design_rationale: I4 is used exclusively with S4 (JavaScript disabled). Script APIs (navigator.getGamepads, etc.) are unreachable under S4 because the JS engine itself is disabled, so pref-gating script APIs in I4 adds no protection that S4 does not already enforce. I4 must therefore target passive, non-script identity signals: request headers (Accept-Language normalization), CSS-visible values (prefers-color-scheme, resolution, pointer, hover), remote font loading, and referrer policy. These signals are emitted by the browser regardless of whether JavaScript is enabled.

controls.override_reason: Normalize Accept-Language header to a static value to prevent language-based fingerprinting via HTTP headers (passive non-script signal)

verify.method: Query Accept-Language header sent by browser to local test server

controls.user_cost: Browser always reports en-US locale regardless of system locale; web pages receive English

controls.override_reason: Block remote font loading in I4 static quarantine to prevent font enumeration fingerprinting via CSS-rendered glyphs and to close the remote-font timing side channel

verify.method: Verify pref value is locked false via Marionette chrome context

controls.user_cost: Pages using custom web fonts fall back to system fonts

controls.override_reason: Trim referrer to origin only and restrict cross-origin referrer to origin on cross-origin requests (passive non-script signal emitted with every navigation)

verify.method: Verify pref values via Marionette chrome context

controls.user_cost: Third-party analytics that rely on full-URL Referer headers receive only the origin

compat_notes: Used exclusively with S4 Static surface in detonation quarantine
dom.gamepad.enabled is NOT listed here: with JavaScript disabled (S4), the Gamepad API is unreachable regardless of this pref. Pref-gating it in I4 would be redundant security theater.
CSS media queries (prefers-color-scheme, resolution, pointer, hover) are emitted passively; normalization requires a patch not yet available in ESR 153 - tracked as OPEN in VERIFY-I-010.
